consumer_scope: Hypothetical CPU temporal-filter weight ablation; not an AMD API or proposed live host change
oracle_scope: Uses hidden per-layer radiance and exact current coverage; background normal/depth are layer moments. Not deployable or per-sample AMD truth.

decoder_calibration.scope: analytic homogeneous known normals, oct quantization only

identifiability_collision.construction: dominant front layer identical; invisible minority layer radiance/motion differs
identifiability_collision.conclusion: A guide-only observer cannot identify the hidden mixture; low uncertainty does not establish homogeneous coverage.
